panels.title: Disk Space Used Basic

matcher.options: Hardware Corrupted - Amount of RAM that the kernel identified as corrupted / not working

targets.expr:
WITH (
    cpuUsage(filter) = rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{filter}),
)
sum(cpuUsage({mode!="idle"})) by (mode) / sum(cpuUsage({})) * 100

WITH (
    cf = {fstype!="tmpfs"},
    f(m) = sum(m{cf}) by (mountpoint),
)
ru(f(node_filesystem_avail_bytes), f(node_filesystem_size_bytes))

WITH (
    memUsage(name, freev) = label_set(sum(freev) / sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) * 100, "name", name),
)
union(
    memUsage("cache", node_memory_Cached_bytes),
    memUsage("buffers", node_memory_Buffers_bytes),
    memUsage("free", node_memory_MemFree_bytes),
    memUsage("used", node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemFree_bytes - node_memory_Cached_bytes - node_memory_Buffers_bytes),
)

WITH (
    diskIO(name, m) = label_set(sum(rate(m)) by (device) / count(m) by (device) * 100, "name", name),
)
union(
    diskIO("read", node_disk_read_time_seconds_total),
    diskIO("write", node_disk_write_time_seconds_total),
)

WITH (
    cf = {device!="lo"},
    netUsage(name, m) = label_set(sum(rate(m{cf})), "name", name),
)
union (
    netUsage("recv", node_network_receive_bytes_total),
    netUsage("send", node_network_transmit_bytes_total),
)

WITH (
    diskUsage(name, m) = label_set(sum(rate(m)) by (device), "name", name),
)
union(
    diskUsage("read", node_disk_read_bytes_total),
    diskUsage("write", node_disk_written_bytes_total),
)
